review_regressions.interpretation: Actual pre-repair working bytes, not missing APIs or setup failures. Caught product exceptions are converted to explicit assertion sentinels.

limits: Controlled provider answers verify composition and evidence rules, not live model accuracy.
Operational witness JSON records supplied dispositions; it does not attest remote execution.
Independent local detection checks make no provider calls; the hosted section records previously collected live artifact usage.

hosted_pr79.identity_basis: Both evaluation artifacts record the tested commit and clean status; its Git second parent is the recorded PR source SHA.

The synthetic storage concern was unsupported by its frozen oracle. Billing and reviewer benefit remain unmeasured.
